card.name: Words completing a comparison or evaluation
card.fires_on: Words right after a comparative adjective like more, much or less plus an evaluative adjective (true, accurate, congenial, better). They are the closing quote, link or preposition that finishes the comparison.

modes.label: Link after comparative
modes.description: A small linking word follows a 'more + adjective' phrase and introduces the comparison's reason or target.

modes.description: The word is the evaluative adjective or its closing quote, after more or much.
